component.name: WordBird
component.summary: Distraction-free novel-writing editor with an AI writing companion

description.p: WordBird is a focused writing app for novelists and long-form storytellers. It pairs a clean, distraction-free WYSIWYG Markdown editor with Biscuit, an integrated AI writing companion that helps you draft chapters, rewrite passages, and refine prose without leaving your manuscript.

ul.li: Realtime preview (WYSIWYG) for a distraction-free writing experience
Biscuit AI companion with line-level inline diff review (Accept / Discard)
CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown support
Math expressions (KaTeX), front matter, Mermaid diagrams, and PlantUML
Focus mode, Typewriter mode, and Source Code mode
Multiple themes, customisable fonts, and HTML/PDF export
